tolerance.metric: maximum absolute error of the measured arm direction against reference_angle, modulo 360/m, over the rotation sweep

anisotropy_diagnostic.observable: theta_m = atan2(S_m, C_m)/m is the arm direction and a_m = sqrt(C_m^2+S_m^2)/area is the m-fold shape amplitude, from C_m = integral w cos(m theta) dA and S_m = integral w sin(m theta) dA taken about the seed centre. Both m = 4 and m = 6 are always computed so the off-mode channel is measured rather than assumed.
anisotropy_diagnostic.measured_at: the first step at which the solid area reaches 3x its initial value. Fixed in advance and geometric: it is late enough for the shape to develop and early enough to precede recalescence.

off_mode.note: The square mesh imprints a four-fold bias on a circle. It is distinguished from physics by refinement, the same test used on the T1-08 contact checkerboard.

recalescence.note: T_max crosses T_e partway through every run. Past that point the driving force atan(gamma(T_e - T)) is negative, the grain melts, and because melting is fastest where growth was slowest the shape inverts by exactly half a lobe -- the m=4 phase steps 0 -> -45 degrees. Every measurement here is taken before that, as the declared measured_at requires.

anisotropy_diagnostic.symmetry_caveat: reference_angle 0 and 30 give S_6 identically zero (order 1e-18) because the configuration is mirror-symmetric about the mesh axis, so those two phases are exact by symmetry rather than by measurement. The informative rotation points are 15 and 45 degrees, which are not mesh-symmetric.

observable_correction.what_was_wrong: The declared observable was the dendrite tip velocity and its scaling with undercooling. This Kobayashi parameter set does not have a steady tip velocity in any domain that fits on this machine. With the insulated 0.7 box the tip decelerated 14.1 -> 1.6 across the window; with a 1.05 quarter-symmetry domain and a Dirichlet far field it decelerates 15.5 -> 10.7 and then STALLS at 0.357 while the melt at x = 0.70 recalesces to T = 0.98. Latent heat with K = 1.8 saturates the domain faster than a boundary sink can drain it. A steady tip needs the thermal layer thin against the domain, roughly L = 3-4 at the same dx, i.e. nx = 300-400: about 17x the elements with LU scaling worse than linearly, days per run for five runs.
observable_correction.window_error_found: The declared window [0.45, 0.58] was in ABSOLUTE mesh coordinates, where the seed sat at x = 0.35 -- it means 0.10 to 0.23 FROM THE SEED CENTRE. The superseded verify.py defines SEED_X = 0.35 and never uses it. So the window began at 1.25x the initial seed radius and ended at 2.9x, spanning the first 10% of the run while the seed was still relaxing off its initial condition. Scored correctly on the far-field data it gives R^2 = 0.9958 against the declared 0.98 -- but that is a short segment of a smooth decelerating curve looking straight, not a steady velocity. The check could not fail, which is the same defect as the coarse load quantization caught in T1-05.
observable_correction.what_replaces_it: The orientation of growth, which this model predicts exactly. The interfacial parameter is eps(theta) = eps_bar [1 + delta cos(m (theta - theta_0))], so the grain must acquire an m-fold shape locked to theta_0. The observable is the angular Fourier content of the solid region: amplitude a_m = sqrt(C_m^2 + S_m^2)/area and phase theta_m = atan2(S_m, C_m)/m, with C_m = integral w cos(m theta) dA about the seed centre. These are volume integrals, so the measurement does not inherit the node-straddling error of an interface crossing.
observable_correction.what_is_given_up: The 'dendrite-growth scaling' half of checklist item 5.3. No tip velocity, no LGK scaling exponent and no steady-state growth claim is made. The retained qualitative result -- tip velocity rises monotonically with undercooling -- is reported as a diagnostic only. This is a genuine reduction in scope and is Carlos's call to accept or reject.
observable_correction.geometry_correction: The far-field runs used a quarter-symmetry domain, justified in writing as 'zero flux on x=0 and y=0 IS the four-fold symmetry condition'. That was wrong: mode_number defaults to SIX in this build, and mirror planes at 90 degrees impose four-fold symmetry on a six-fold model. The re-scoped case uses a FULL domain with the seed at the centre.
